name: Grain export funds the treasury
description: OpenRepublic-authored synthetic trade setup: a grain-producing border post exports priced grain to earn treasury funds before importing declared coal.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
resource grain
trade grain buy 5 sell 3
resource coal
trade coal buy 7 sell 4
utility power
building grain_trade_post 1 1
  store grain 64
  store coal 100
  recipe harvest every 1 out grain:2
  tradepost
end
building generator 1 1
  recipe generate every 1 out power:2
end
